# Third-party release notice index

Production packaging includes `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, `MODEL_LICENSES.md`, the
machine-readable `dependencies.json`, and available licence texts from
`third_party/licenses/`.

The current production paths use libsndfile 1.2.2, libebur128 1.2.6, ONNX Runtime
1.26.0, Windows Media Foundation, and an on-demand HTDemucs ONNX model. Consult
the top-level notice files for integration and redistribution details.
